name: learningmanage-stage3-evals
description: Offline and real-provider evaluation gates for LearningManage Stage 3

scripts.prepare:eval: npm run validate:datasets && npm run build:tests
scripts.validate: npm run prepare:eval && node scripts/run-promptfoo.mjs validate config -c promptfooconfig.yaml
scripts.eval:stub: npm run prepare:eval && node scripts/run-promptfoo.mjs eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml -o output.json --no-cache --no-share --max-concurrency 1
scripts.eval:real: npm run prepare:eval && node scripts/run-promptfoo.mjs eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml -o output.json --no-cache --no-share --max-concurrency 1
